core-description-length.name: Meta Description Length

core-canonical-present.name: Canonical URL Present
core-canonical-present.description: Checks that a <link rel="canonical"> tag exists in the document
core-canonical-present.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="..."> to specify preferred URL

core-canonical-valid.name: Canonical URL Valid
core-canonical-valid.description: Checks that the canonical URL is a valid absolute URL
core-canonical-valid.fix: Ensure canonical URL is absolute, accessible, and returns 200 status

core-viewport-present.name: Viewport Meta Tag Present
core-viewport-present.description: Checks that a <meta name="viewport"> tag exists in the document

core-favicon-present.name: Favicon Present
core-favicon-present.description: Checks that a <link rel="icon"> or <link rel="shortcut icon"> tag exists
core-favicon-present.fix: Add <link rel="icon" href="/favicon.ico"> or PNG/SVG favicon

core-h1-present.name: H1 Tag Present
core-h1-present.description: Checks that at least one <h1> tag exists in the document
core-h1-present.fix: Add a single H1 tag that describes the page main topic

core-h1-single.name: Single H1 Tag
core-h1-single.description: Checks that only one <h1> tag exists in the document
core-h1-single.fix: Use only one H1 per page; use H2-H6 for subsections

core-canonical-header.name: Canonical Header Validation
core-canonical-header.description: Detects mismatch between HTML canonical tag and HTTP Link header
core-canonical-header.fix: Use HTML canonical only; reserve Link header for PDFs and non-HTML resources

core-nosnippet.name: Nosnippet Directive
core-nosnippet.description: Detects pages preventing search engine snippets
core-nosnippet.fix: Remove nosnippet directive unless intentionally blocking search snippets

core-robots-meta.name: Robots Meta
core-robots-meta.description: Checks robots meta tag for indexing directives
core-robots-meta.fix: Remove noindex/nofollow unless intentionally blocking search engines

core-title-unique.name: Title Uniqueness
core-title-unique.description: Checks that page titles are unique across the site
core-title-unique.fix: Create unique titles for each page: "Page Topic | Brand Name"

core-canonical-conflicting.name: Conflicting Canonical URLs
core-canonical-conflicting.description: Checks if multiple canonical URLs are specified via HTML and HTTP header pointing to different URLs
core-canonical-conflicting.fix: Resolve conflicting canonical signals; ensure HTML canonical, Link header, and sitemap agree on the preferred URL

core-canonical-to-homepage.name: Canonical Pointing to Homepage
core-canonical-to-homepage.description: Checks if a non-homepage has its canonical URL pointing to the homepage
core-canonical-to-homepage.fix: Update canonical to point to the actual page URL, not the homepage; each page should self-reference

core-canonical-http-mismatch.name: Canonical Protocol Mismatch
core-canonical-http-mismatch.description: Checks if canonical URL protocol mismatches the page protocol (HTTP vs HTTPS)
core-canonical-http-mismatch.fix: Ensure canonical URL uses the same protocol (HTTP/HTTPS) as the page; prefer HTTPS

core-canonical-loop.name: Canonical Loop Detection
core-canonical-loop.description: Checks if canonical URL may create a loop (non-self-referencing canonical)
core-canonical-loop.fix: Break the canonical loop by pointing canonical to a single, self-referencing final URL

core-canonical-to-noindex.name: Canonical and Noindex Conflict
core-canonical-to-noindex.description: Checks if a page has both noindex and a canonical pointing to a different URL (conflicting signals)
core-canonical-to-noindex.fix: Either remove noindex from the canonical target or change canonical to point to an indexable page

core-canonical-outside-head.name: Canonical Outside Head
core-canonical-outside-head.description: Checks that no <link rel="canonical"> element appears outside the <head>
core-canonical-outside-head.fix: Move the <link rel="canonical"> element into the <head>; canonicals outside <head> are ignored

core-canonical-attributes.name: Canonical Attributes
core-canonical-attributes.description: Checks that <link rel="canonical"> elements carry only rel and href attributes
core-canonical-attributes.fix: Remove invalid or superfluous attributes from canonical elements; keep only rel and href

core-canonical-multiple.name: Multiple Canonical Tags
core-canonical-multiple.description: Checks for multiple <link rel="canonical"> elements in the HTML and whether they agree
core-canonical-multiple.fix: Keep a single <link rel="canonical"> element pointing at the correct URL

core-canonical-external.name: Canonical Points To External URL
core-canonical-external.description: Reports when the canonical URL points to a different host (legitimate for syndication, worth verifying)
core-canonical-external.fix: Confirm this cross-domain canonical is intentional; the page cedes its ranking signals to the other host

core-robots-directive-mismatch.name: Robots Directive Mismatch
core-robots-directive-mismatch.description: Checks that robots directives in meta tags and the X-Robots-Tag header are consistent and not duplicated
core-robots-directive-mismatch.fix: Align robots directives between meta tags and X-Robots-Tag header; declare noindex/nofollow in one place only

technical-robots-txt-exists.name: Robots.txt Exists
technical-robots-txt-exists.description: Checks that the site has a robots.txt file accessible at /robots.txt
technical-robots-txt-exists.fix: Create robots.txt at site root with User-agent and sitemap directives

technical-robots-txt-valid.name: Robots.txt Valid Syntax
technical-robots-txt-valid.description: Checks that robots.txt file has valid syntax with User-agent and Allow/Disallow directives
technical-robots-txt-valid.fix: Fix syntax errors in robots.txt; use standard directives only

technical-sitemap-exists.name: Sitemap Exists
technical-sitemap-exists.description: Checks that a sitemap.xml exists at /sitemap.xml or is referenced in robots.txt
technical-sitemap-exists.fix: Create XML sitemap at /sitemap.xml and reference in robots.txt

technical-sitemap-valid.name: Sitemap Valid Structure
technical-sitemap-valid.description: Checks that the sitemap has valid XML structure with proper elements
technical-sitemap-valid.fix: Fix sitemap XML errors; ensure all URLs are accessible

technical-url-structure.name: URL Structure
technical-url-structure.description: Checks that URL uses hyphens (not underscores), is lowercase, and has reasonable length
technical-url-structure.fix: Use clean URLs with hyphens, lowercase, and descriptive slugs

technical-trailing-slash.name: Trailing Slash Consistency
technical-trailing-slash.description: Checks for consistent trailing slash usage across internal links
technical-trailing-slash.fix: Be consistent with trailing slashes; redirect duplicates

technical-www-redirect.name: WWW Redirect
technical-www-redirect.description: Checks that www and non-www versions redirect to one canonical version
technical-www-redirect.fix: Choose www or non-www and redirect the other version

technical-404-page.name: Custom 404 Page
technical-404-page.description: Checks that the site has a custom 404 page (not a default server error)
technical-404-page.fix: Create custom 404 page with navigation links and search

technical-soft-404.name: Soft 404 Detection
technical-soft-404.description: Detects pages that return HTTP 200 but display error page content (soft 404)
technical-soft-404.fix: Return proper 404 status code for missing pages instead of 200; avoid soft 404s that waste crawl budget

technical-server-error.name: Server Error Detection
technical-server-error.description: Checks if the page returns a 5xx server error status code
technical-server-error.fix: Fix 5xx server errors; check server logs, increase resources, or fix application bugs

technical-4xx-non-404.name: 4xx Client Error Detection
technical-4xx-non-404.description: Checks for 4xx client errors other than 404 (e.g., 401, 403, 410, 429)
technical-4xx-non-404.fix: Fix 4xx errors (403 Forbidden, 410 Gone, etc.); check permissions, authentication, and removed content

technical-timeout.name: Response Timeout Check
technical-timeout.description: Checks if the page response time is excessive, indicating a near-timeout condition
technical-timeout.fix: Reduce page response time; optimize server, enable caching, or increase timeout thresholds

technical-bad-content-type.name: Content-Type Header Check
technical-bad-content-type.description: Checks that the Content-Type header is correct for an HTML page
technical-bad-content-type.fix: Set correct Content-Type header matching actual content (text/html for pages, application/json for APIs)

technical-empty-html.name: Empty HTML
technical-empty-html.description: Checks that the page returns meaningful HTML content rather than an empty document
technical-empty-html.fix: Investigate why the server returns no HTML content; restore it or serve a 404/410 if it should not exist

technical-form-get-method.name: Form GET Method
technical-form-get-method.description: Detects forms that submit with the GET method, exposing query-string URLs
technical-form-get-method.fix: Switch forms to method="post", or block GET form action URLs via robots.txt if they are intentional

technical-duplicate-gtm.name: Multiple Google Tag Manager Containers
technical-duplicate-gtm.description: Detects pages embedding more than one distinct Google Tag Manager container ID
technical-duplicate-gtm.fix: Verify all GTM containers are intentional; consolidate into a single container where possible

technical-duplicate-ga.name: Multiple Google Analytics Properties
technical-duplicate-ga.description: Detects pages embedding more than one distinct Google Analytics property ID (UA- or G-)
technical-duplicate-ga.fix: Verify all Google Analytics properties are intentional; remove duplicate or legacy tracking codes

technical-consent-mode.name: Google Consent Mode
technical-consent-mode.description: Checks that a page loading Google tags also includes a consent update
technical-consent-mode.fix: Call gtag consent default with ad_storage, ad_user_data, and ad_personalization before the Google tag

cwv-lcp.name: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)
cwv-lcp.description: Measures loading performance by checking when the largest content element becomes visible
cwv-lcp.fix: Optimize LCP: preload hero images, use CDN, reduce server response time

cwv-cls.name: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)
cwv-cls.description: Measures visual stability by checking how much the page layout shifts during loading
cwv-cls.fix: Prevent CLS: set width/height on images and embeds, avoid dynamic content injection

cwv-inp.name: Interaction to Next Paint (INP)
cwv-inp.description: Measures responsiveness by checking the latency of user interactions
cwv-inp.fix: Reduce INP: optimize JavaScript, break long tasks, use web workers

cwv-ttfb.name: Time to First Byte (TTFB)
cwv-ttfb.description: Measures server response time by checking how long until the first byte is received
cwv-ttfb.fix: Lower TTFB: use CDN, enable caching, optimize database queries

cwv-fcp.name: First Contentful Paint (FCP)
cwv-fcp.description: Measures perceived load speed by checking when the first content is rendered
cwv-fcp.fix: Improve FCP: inline critical CSS, defer non-critical scripts, preload fonts

perf-dom-size.name: DOM Size
perf-dom-size.description: Checks DOM size for performance impact (nodes, depth, children)
perf-dom-size.fix: Reduce DOM size: remove unused elements, use virtualization for long lists

perf-css-file-size.name: CSS File Size
perf-css-file-size.description: Checks CSS file count and inline CSS size for performance
perf-css-file-size.fix: Bundle and minify CSS; use critical CSS inline, defer non-critical

perf-font-loading.name: Font Loading
perf-font-loading.description: Checks for font loading best practices (font-display, preload)
perf-font-loading.fix: Add font-display: swap to @font-face; preload critical fonts

perf-preconnect.name: Preconnect Hints
perf-preconnect.description: Checks for preconnect hints to critical third-party origins
perf-preconnect.fix: Add <link rel="preconnect" href="..."> for third-party origins

perf-render-blocking.name: Render-Blocking Resources
perf-render-blocking.description: Checks for render-blocking CSS and JavaScript in the head
perf-render-blocking.fix: Add async/defer to scripts; use media queries for non-critical CSS

perf-lazy-above-fold.name: Lazy Loading Above Fold
perf-lazy-above-fold.description: Detects lazy loading on above-fold images that should load immediately
perf-lazy-above-fold.fix: Remove loading="lazy" from above-fold images; add fetchpriority="high"

perf-lcp-hints.name: LCP Optimization Hints
perf-lcp-hints.description: Checks for Largest Contentful Paint optimization (preload, fetchpriority)
perf-lcp-hints.fix: Preload LCP image with <link rel="preload" as="image">; add fetchpriority="high"

perf-text-compression.name: Text Compression
perf-text-compression.description: Checks if the response uses text compression (gzip, br, deflate, zstd)
perf-text-compression.fix: Enable gzip or Brotli compression on the server for text-based responses (HTML, CSS, JS)

perf-brotli.name: Brotli Compression
perf-brotli.description: Checks if Brotli compression is used instead of gzip for better compression
perf-brotli.fix: Enable Brotli compression for 15-25% better compression than gzip; configure server or CDN

perf-asset-compression.name: Text Asset Compression

perf-cache-policy.name: Cache Policy

perf-asset-cache-policy.description: Checks that static assets (CSS, JS, images, fonts) carry a cache-control max-age of at least 1 hour

perf-minify-css.name: Minify Inline CSS

perf-minify-css.fix: Minify CSS files to remove whitespace and comments; use cssnano or lightningcss

perf-minify-js.name: Minify Inline JS

perf-response-time.name: Response Time

perf-page-weight.name: Page Weight

perf-js-file-size.name: Inline JS Size

links-internal-present.name: Internal Links Present
