links-nofollow-appropriate.fix: Use nofollow only for untrusted, sponsored, or user-generated links

links-anchor-text.name: Descriptive Anchor Text
links-anchor-text.description: Checks that link anchor text is descriptive and not generic like "click here" or "read more"
links-anchor-text.fix: Use descriptive anchor text instead of "click here" or "read more"

links-depth.name: Page Depth
links-depth.description: Checks click distance from the crawl entry point (more than 3 clicks is hard to reach)
links-depth.fix: Ensure important pages are within 3 clicks from homepage

links-dead-end-pages.name: No Dead-End Pages
links-dead-end-pages.description: Checks that pages have at least one outgoing internal link for navigation
links-dead-end-pages.fix: Add navigation links, related content, or breadcrumbs to avoid dead ends

links-https-downgrade.name: No HTTPS Downgrade Links
links-https-downgrade.description: Checks that HTTPS pages do not link to HTTP URLs
links-https-downgrade.fix: Update HTTP links to HTTPS or remove insecure external links

links-external-count.name: External Links Count
links-external-count.description: Checks that pages do not have an excessive number of external links
links-external-count.fix: Reduce external links to essential, high-quality resources only

links-invalid.name: No Invalid Links
links-invalid.description: Checks for empty, javascript:, or malformed link hrefs
links-invalid.fix: Replace javascript: links with buttons, fix malformed URLs

links-tel-mailto.name: Valid Tel & Mailto Links
links-tel-mailto.description: Checks that tel: and mailto: links have valid formats
links-tel-mailto.fix: Use E.164 format for phone (+1234567890), valid email for mailto

links-redirect-chains.name: No Redirect Chains
links-redirect-chains.description: Checks that internal links do not go through multiple redirects
links-redirect-chains.fix: Update links to point directly to final destination URLs

links-orphan-pages.name: Inbound Internal Links
links-orphan-pages.description: Measures how many internal pages link to this one; true zero-inbound orphans are covered by crawl-sitemap-orphan-urls
links-orphan-pages.fix: Add internal links from other pages to improve discoverability

links-localhost.name: No Localhost Links
links-localhost.description: Checks for links pointing to localhost, 127.0.0.1, or common development server ports
links-localhost.fix: Remove localhost and 127.0.0.1 links before deploying to production

links-local-file.name: No Local File References
links-local-file.description: Checks for file:// protocol links and absolute OS filesystem paths in href/src attributes
links-local-file.fix: Remove file:// protocol links; use relative or absolute HTTP URLs instead

links-broken-fragment.name: No Broken Fragment Links
links-broken-fragment.description: Checks that internal fragment links (#id) reference existing elements on the page
links-broken-fragment.fix: Fix or remove fragment links (#anchor) pointing to non-existent IDs on the page

links-excessive.name: Reasonable Link Count
links-excessive.description: Checks that the page does not contain an excessive number of links
links-excessive.fix: Reduce total number of links on the page; too many links dilute PageRank and confuse crawlers

links-onclick.name: No Onclick Navigation
links-onclick.description: Checks for elements using onclick handlers for navigation instead of proper href attributes
links-onclick.fix: Replace onclick navigation with proper <a href="..."> links for crawlability and accessibility

links-whitespace-href.name: No Whitespace in Hrefs
links-whitespace-href.description: Checks for links with whitespace-only or leading/trailing whitespace in href attributes
links-whitespace-href.fix: Trim whitespace from href attributes; ensure URLs are clean and properly formatted

links-non-http-protocol.name: No Non-HTTP Protocol Links
links-non-http-protocol.description: Checks for anchor links using protocols other than HTTP(S), tel: or mailto: (e.g. ftp:, file:, intent:)
links-non-http-protocol.fix: Replace non-HTTP links (ftp:, file:, intent:) with HTTP(S) URLs unless the protocol is intentional

links-inbound-all-nofollow.name: Inbound Links All Nofollow
links-inbound-all-nofollow.description: Warns when every internal link pointing to this page is nofollow, so no link equity reaches it
links-inbound-all-nofollow.fix: Remove nofollow from internal links pointing to this page if it should receive ranking signal

links-inbound-mixed-follow.name: Mixed Follow/Nofollow Inbound Links
links-inbound-mixed-follow.description: Warns when a page receives both followed and nofollowed internal links, suggesting inconsistent nofollow usage
links-inbound-mixed-follow.fix: Decide whether internal links to this page should be nofollowed and apply it consistently

links-inbound-low-quality.name: Inbound Links Passing No Link Equity
links-inbound-low-quality.description: Warns when every inbound internal link is nofollow or comes from a canonicalized page, so none pass link equity
links-inbound-low-quality.fix: Earn followed links from indexable, self-canonical pages so this URL receives internal link equity

links-inbound-anchor-text.name: Descriptive Inbound Anchor Text
links-inbound-anchor-text.description: Warns when every followed internal link pointing to this page uses generic anchor text like "click here"
links-inbound-anchor-text.fix: Use descriptive anchor text on internal links pointing to this page instead of "click here"

links-nofollow-internal.name: Nofollow On Internal Links
links-nofollow-internal.description: Checks that same-host links do not carry rel=nofollow
links-nofollow-internal.fix: Remove rel=nofollow from links to your own pages so crawlers can follow the internal graph

links-weak-inbound.name: Single Inbound Link
links-weak-inbound.description: Checks that a non-entry page has more than one dofollow inbound internal link
links-weak-inbound.fix: Add a second followed internal link to this page from a relevant URL

links-chrome-inbound.name: Chrome-Only Inbound Links
links-chrome-inbound.description: Checks that a page has at least one inbound internal link outside nav, header, and footer
links-chrome-inbound.fix: Link to this page from body copy, not only from the nav, header, or footer

images-alt-present.name: Image Alt Attribute Present
images-alt-present.description: Checks that all images have alt attributes for accessibility and SEO
images-alt-present.fix: Add descriptive alt text to all images for accessibility and SEO

images-alt-quality.name: Image Alt Text Quality
images-alt-quality.description: Checks that image alt text is descriptive and not generic like "image" or "photo"
images-alt-quality.fix: Write meaningful alt text describing image content, not just keywords

images-dimensions.name: Image Dimensions
images-dimensions.description: Checks that images have width and height attributes to prevent layout shift (CLS)
images-dimensions.fix: Add width and height attributes to prevent layout shifts

images-lazy-loading.name: Image Lazy Loading
images-lazy-loading.description: Checks that images below the fold use loading="lazy" for better performance

images-modern-format.name: Modern Image Formats
images-modern-format.description: Checks that modern image formats like WebP or AVIF are used for better compression
images-modern-format.fix: Convert images to WebP or AVIF for better compression

images-size.name: Image File Size
images-size.description: Checks that images are not excessively large (warns if estimated >200KB)
images-size.fix: Compress images to reduce file size while maintaining quality

images-responsive.name: Responsive Images
images-responsive.description: Checks that images use srcset or picture elements for responsive design
images-responsive.fix: Use srcset and sizes for responsive images on different devices

images-broken.name: No Broken Images
images-broken.description: Checks that all images are accessible (no 404 errors)
images-broken.fix: Fix or remove broken image references (404 errors)

images-figure-captions.name: Figure Captions
images-figure-captions.description: Checks for proper use of figure and figcaption elements
images-figure-captions.fix: Add figcaption elements to describe figure content for accessibility

images-filename-quality.name: Image Filename Quality
images-filename-quality.description: Checks for descriptive image filenames (not IMG_001.jpg)
images-filename-quality.fix: Use descriptive filenames like "red-running-shoes.jpg" instead of "IMG_001.jpg"

images-inline-svg-size.name: Inline SVG Size
images-inline-svg-size.description: Checks for large inline SVGs that bloat HTML (>5KB should be external)
images-inline-svg-size.fix: Move large SVGs (>5KB) to external files for better caching

images-picture-element.name: Picture Element Validation
images-picture-element.description: Validates that picture elements have required img fallback
images-picture-element.fix: Ensure every element contains an fallback element

images-alt-length.name: Image Alt Text Length
images-alt-length.description: Checks that image alt text is not excessively long (over 125 characters)
images-alt-length.fix: Keep alt text between 5-125 characters; be descriptive but concise

images-background-seo.name: Background Images SEO
images-background-seo.description: Checks for important images loaded as CSS background images (not crawlable by search engines)
images-background-seo.fix: Use tags instead of CSS background-image for meaningful content images so search engines can index them

security-https.name: HTTPS
security-https.description: Checks that the page is served over HTTPS
security-https.fix: Install SSL certificate and redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS

security-https-redirect.name: HTTP to HTTPS Redirect
security-https-redirect.description: Checks that HTTP requests redirect to HTTPS
security-https-redirect.fix: Ensure HTTP to HTTPS redirect is in place

security-hsts.name: HSTS Header
security-hsts.description: Checks that Strict-Transport-Security header is present with appropriate settings
security-hsts.fix: Add Strict-Transport-Security header with max-age of at least 1 year

security-csp.name: Content-Security-Policy
security-csp.description: Checks that Content-Security-Policy header is present
security-csp.fix: Implement Content-Security-Policy header to prevent XSS attacks

security-x-frame-options.name: X-Frame-Options
security-x-frame-options.description: Checks that X-Frame-Options header is set to DENY or SAMEORIGIN to prevent clickjacking
security-x-frame-options.fix: Add X-Frame-Options: DENY or SAMEORIGIN to prevent clickjacking

security-x-content-type-options.name: X-Content-Type-Options
security-x-content-type-options.description: Checks that X-Content-Type-Options is set to nosniff to prevent MIME type sniffing

security-external-links.name: External Link Security
security-external-links.description: Checks external target="_blank" links for noopener and noreferrer
security-external-links.fix: Add rel="noopener noreferrer" to external target="_blank" links

security-form-https.name: Form HTTPS
security-form-https.description: Checks that form actions use HTTPS
security-form-https.fix: Update form actions to use HTTPS URLs

security-mixed-content.name: Mixed Content
security-mixed-content.description: Checks for HTTP resources on HTTPS pages
security-mixed-content.fix: Replace HTTP resource URLs with HTTPS or use protocol-relative URLs

security-permissions-policy.name: Permissions-Policy
security-permissions-policy.fix: Add Permissions-Policy header to control browser features

security-leaked-secrets.name: Leaked Secrets
security-leaked-secrets.description: Detects exposed API keys, credentials, and secrets in HTML/JS
security-leaked-secrets.fix: Remove exposed secrets immediately and rotate compromised credentials

security-password-http.name: Password Input on HTTP
security-password-http.description: Checks if password inputs are served over insecure HTTP
security-password-http.fix: Never submit passwords over HTTP; ensure all login forms use HTTPS action URLs

security-protocol-relative.name: Protocol-Relative URLs
security-protocol-relative.description: Checks for protocol-relative URLs (starting with //) in resource references
security-protocol-relative.fix: Replace protocol-relative URLs (//example.com) with explicit https:// URLs

security-ssl-expiry.name: SSL Certificate Health
security-ssl-expiry.description: Checks SSL health indicators via HSTS max-age as a proxy for certificate maintenance
security-ssl-expiry.fix: Renew SSL certificate before expiry; set up auto-renewal with Let's Encrypt or your CA

security-ssl-protocol.name: TLS Protocol Configuration
security-ssl-protocol.description: Checks TLS configuration quality through HSTS directives and security header indicators
security-ssl-protocol.fix: Disable TLS 1.0/1.1; require TLS 1.2+ for secure connections

security-cookie-flags.name: Cookie Security Flags
security-cookie-flags.description: Checks Set-Cookie headers for Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite attributes on session cookies
security-cookie-flags.fix: Set Secure and SameSite on all cookies, and HttpOnly on session cookies

security-cookie-lifetime.name: Cookie Lifetime
security-cookie-lifetime.description: Flags cookies with excessive expiry beyond the 400-day browser cap
security-cookie-lifetime.fix: Reduce cookie expiry below the 400-day browser cap; long-lived identifiers raise privacy obligations

security-coop.name: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy
security-coop.description: Checks that Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy isolates the page from windows that open it

security-csp-xss.name: CSP Strength Against XSS
security-csp-xss.description: Checks that the Content-Security-Policy actually constrains script execution
security-csp-xss.fix: Remove unsafe-inline and wildcard script sources from CSP or add nonces/hashes; set object-src and base-uri

security-info-disclosure.name: Software Version Disclosure
security-info-disclosure.description: Checks that response headers do not advertise the server software and its version
security-info-disclosure.fix: Suppress or genericise headers that reveal software versions (Server, X-Powered-By, X-Generator)

security-paste-blocking.name: Inputs Allow Pasting
security-paste-blocking.description: Checks that input fields do not prevent pasting
security-paste-blocking.fix: Remove onpaste handlers that cancel pasting; blocking paste breaks password managers

security-trusted-types.name: Trusted Types
security-trusted-types.description: Checks that the Content-Security-Policy requires Trusted Types for DOM XSS sinks
security-trusted-types.fix: Add require-trusted-types-for 'script' to the Content-Security-Policy to block DOM XSS sinks

security-sri.name: Subresource Integrity
security-sri.description: Checks that cross-origin scripts and stylesheets set an integrity hash
security-sri.fix: Add an integrity hash and crossorigin="anonymous" to cross-origin scripts and stylesheets

security-obfuscated-script.name: Obfuscated Inline Script
security-obfuscated-script.description: Checks for a long, high-entropy inline script that calls eval, Function, or atob
security-obfuscated-script.fix: Remove long inline scripts that call eval, Function, or atob and that you do not recognise

security-brand-impersonation.name: Brand Sign-In Destination
security-brand-impersonation.description: Checks that brand sign-in links point at the brand or stay on this host
security-brand-impersonation.fix: Point Sign in with Google, Microsoft, or Apple at that brand or at a URL on your own host

crawl-schema-noindex-conflict.name: Schema + Noindex Conflict
crawl-schema-noindex-conflict.description: Detects pages with rich result schema that are blocked from indexing
crawl-schema-noindex-conflict.fix: Remove noindex to allow rich results, or remove schema markup if page should stay hidden

crawl-pagination-canonical.name: Pagination Canonical
crawl-pagination-canonical.description: Checks that paginated pages have self-referencing canonicals
crawl-pagination-canonical.fix: Each paginated page should have self-referencing canonical; do not canonicalize all pages to page 1

crawl-sitemap-domain.name: Sitemap Domain Validation
crawl-sitemap-domain.description: Checks that all sitemap URLs belong to the expected domain
crawl-sitemap-domain.fix: Remove cross-domain URLs from sitemap; all URLs must match sitemap host domain

crawl-noindex-in-sitemap.name: Noindex in Sitemap
crawl-noindex-in-sitemap.description: Checks for noindexed pages listed in sitemap
crawl-noindex-in-sitemap.fix: Either remove noindexed page from sitemap or remove the noindex directive

crawl-indexability-conflict.name: Indexability Conflict
crawl-indexability-conflict.description: Detects conflicts between robots.txt and noindex directives
crawl-indexability-conflict.fix: Choose one blocking method: either robots.txt disallow OR noindex meta, not both

crawl-canonical-redirect.name: Canonical Redirect Chain
crawl-canonical-redirect.description: Checks that canonical URLs do not redirect
crawl-canonical-redirect.fix: Update canonical to point directly to final destination URL; avoid redirect chains

crawl-sitemap-url-limit.name: Sitemap URL Limit
crawl-sitemap-url-limit.description: Checks if sitemap exceeds the 50,000 URL limit per file
crawl-sitemap-url-limit.fix: Split sitemaps with >50,000 URLs into multiple files using a sitemap index

crawl-sitemap-size-limit.name: Sitemap Size Limit
crawl-sitemap-size-limit.description: Checks if sitemap exceeds the 50 MB uncompressed size limit
crawl-sitemap-size-limit.fix: Split sitemaps larger than 50MB into smaller files using a sitemap index

crawl-sitemap-duplicate-urls.name: Sitemap Duplicate URLs
crawl-sitemap-duplicate-urls.description: Checks for duplicate URLs in sitemap
crawl-sitemap-duplicate-urls.fix: Remove duplicate URLs from sitemap; each URL should appear only once

crawl-sitemap-orphan-urls.name: Sitemap Orphan URLs
crawl-sitemap-orphan-urls.description: Checks if sitemap contains URLs not linked from any crawled page
crawl-sitemap-orphan-urls.fix: Add internal links to sitemap-only pages or remove them from the sitemap if they are unimportant

crawl-blocked-resources.name: Blocked Resources
crawl-blocked-resources.description: Checks if robots.txt blocks important CSS/JS resources
crawl-blocked-resources.fix: Unblock CSS and JS files in robots.txt so search engines can render pages correctly

crawl-blocked-images.name: Blocked Images
crawl-blocked-images.description: Flags image URLs that are disallowed by robots.txt
crawl-blocked-images.fix: Allow image paths in robots.txt, or serve images from a path that is not disallowed

crawl-crawl-delay.name: Crawl Delay
crawl-crawl-delay.description: Checks for Crawl-delay directive in robots.txt
crawl-crawl-delay.fix: Remove or reduce crawl-delay in robots.txt; excessive delays slow indexing

crawl-sitemap-in-robotstxt.name: Sitemap in robots.txt
crawl-sitemap-in-robotstxt.description: Checks if robots.txt references the sitemap
crawl-sitemap-in-robotstxt.fix: Add Sitemap: https://example.com/sitemap.xml directive to robots.txt

crawl-pagination-broken.name: Pagination Broken Links
crawl-pagination-broken.description: Checks if pagination rel="next"/"prev" links have valid URLs
crawl-pagination-broken.fix: Fix broken rel=prev/next links; ensure paginated URLs are accessible and return 200

crawl-pagination-loop.name: Pagination Loop Detection
crawl-pagination-loop.description: Checks if pagination creates a loop by pointing back to the current page
crawl-pagination-loop.fix: Fix pagination loop where pages link back to earlier pages in the sequence

crawl-pagination-sequence.name: Pagination Sequence Validation
crawl-pagination-sequence.description: Checks if pagination follows proper sequence (next and prev are different)
crawl-pagination-sequence.fix: Ensure pagination follows correct sequential order (page 1 → 2 → 3); fix gaps or misordering

crawl-pagination-noindex.name: Pagination Noindex Check
crawl-pagination-noindex.description: Checks if paginated pages have noindex directive
crawl-pagination-noindex.fix: Remove noindex from paginated pages; use self-referencing canonicals instead to preserve link equity

crawl-pagination-orphaned.name: Pagination Orphaned
crawl-pagination-orphaned.description: Checks if paginated pages are missing rel="next"/"prev" relationships
crawl-pagination-orphaned.fix: Link paginated pages from the main listing page or navigation; orphaned pagination pages may not be crawled

crawl-sitemap-lastmod.name: Sitemap lastmod Quality
crawl-sitemap-lastmod.description: Checks sitemap <lastmod> values for invalid dates, future dates, and bulk-identical timestamps
crawl-sitemap-lastmod.fix: Use truthful, valid W3C Datetime <lastmod> values; avoid future dates and stamping every URL with the same date

crawl-pagination-isolated.name: Pagination URL Without Incoming Links
crawl-pagination-isolated.description: Checks that paginated URLs receive at least one incoming internal link
crawl-pagination-isolated.fix: Link to paginated pages from ordinary anchors (e.g. a pager in the body), not only rel="next"/"prev" tags

crawl-sitemap-non-200.name: Non-200 URLs in Sitemap
crawl-sitemap-non-200.description: Cross-references sitemap URLs against crawled status codes; fails on 4xx/5xx, warns on 3xx and timed-out URLs
crawl-sitemap-non-200.fix: Remove erroring URLs from the sitemap or fix their responses; list final destination URLs, not redirects

crawl-sitemap-non-canonical.name: Canonicalised URLs in Sitemap
crawl-sitemap-non-canonical.description: Flags sitemap URLs whose canonical link element resolves to a different URL
crawl-sitemap-non-canonical.fix: List canonical target URLs in the sitemap instead of URLs that canonicalize away

crawl-sitemap-disallowed.name: Disallowed URLs in Sitemap
crawl-sitemap-disallowed.description: Flags sitemap URLs that robots.txt disallows, a direct contradiction of crawl signals
crawl-sitemap-disallowed.fix: Remove disallowed URLs from the sitemap or allow them in robots.txt, whichever reflects intent

crawl-sitemap-cross-duplicates.name: URLs in Multiple Sitemaps
crawl-sitemap-cross-duplicates.description: Flags page URLs declared by more than one sitemap document
crawl-sitemap-cross-duplicates.fix: Assign each URL to a single sitemap so coverage reporting stays meaningful

crawl-canonical-to-noindex.name: Canonical Points To Noindex URL
crawl-canonical-to-noindex.description: Checks that the canonical target is not itself noindex
crawl-canonical-to-noindex.fix: Point the canonical at an indexable URL, or remove noindex from the canonical target

crawl-canonical-to-disallowed.name: Canonical Points To Disallowed URL
crawl-canonical-to-disallowed.description: Checks that the canonical target is not disallowed by robots.txt
crawl-canonical-to-disallowed.fix: Point the canonical at a crawlable URL, or remove the robots.txt disallow for the target

crawl-canonical-chain.name: Canonical Chain
crawl-canonical-chain.description: Checks that the canonical target is not itself canonicalized to a different URL
crawl-canonical-chain.fix: Point the canonical directly at the final canonical URL instead of chaining through intermediate pages

crawl-canonical-loop.name: Canonical Loop
crawl-canonical-loop.description: Checks that following canonical targets does not loop back to a visited URL
crawl-canonical-loop.fix: Make every page in the loop canonicalize to a single final URL

crawl-hreflang-to-noindex.name: Hreflang To Noindex URLs
crawl-hreflang-to-noindex.description: Checks that outgoing hreflang annotations do not point to noindex URLs
crawl-hreflang-to-noindex.fix: Remove noindex from hreflang targets, or drop the annotations pointing at them

crawl-hreflang-to-disallowed.name: Hreflang To Disallowed URLs
crawl-hreflang-to-disallowed.description: Checks that outgoing hreflang annotations do not point to robots.txt-disallowed URLs
crawl-hreflang-to-disallowed.fix: Remove the robots.txt disallow for the hreflang targets, or drop the annotations pointing at them

crawl-hreflang-disallowed-target.name: Disallowed URL Has Incoming Hreflang
crawl-hreflang-disallowed-target.description: Checks that no other page points hreflang annotations at this robots.txt-disallowed page
crawl-hreflang-disallowed-target.fix: Remove the robots.txt disallow for this URL, or remove the hreflang annotations pointing at it

crawl-hreflang-incoming-conflict.name: Conflicting Incoming Hreflang Annotations
crawl-hreflang-incoming-conflict.description: Checks that other crawled pages do not annotate this URL with conflicting hreflang codes
crawl-hreflang-incoming-conflict.fix: Make every page in the hreflang cluster annotate each member URL with the same single language/region code

crawl-hreflang-reciprocity.name: Hreflang Reciprocity
crawl-hreflang-reciprocity.description: Checks that crawled hreflang targets annotate this page in return (return tags)
crawl-hreflang-reciprocity.fix: Add reciprocal hreflang annotations on the target pages pointing back at this URL

crawl-isolated-url.name: Isolated URL
crawl-isolated-url.description: Checks that the page is reachable through ordinary internal links, not only canonicals, redirects or the sitemap
crawl-isolated-url.fix: Link to this page from ordinary anchors on relevant, indexable pages; do not rely on canonicals or the sitemap

crawl-canonical-form-drift.name: Canonical Form Drift
crawl-canonical-form-drift.description: Checks that crawled canonicals agree on www, scheme, and trailing slash
crawl-canonical-form-drift.fix: Use one canonical host, scheme, and trailing-slash form on every page

crawl-sitemap-date-drift.name: Sitemap Date Drift
crawl-sitemap-date-drift.description: Checks that sitemap lastmod and schema dateModified fall on the same day
crawl-sitemap-date-drift.fix: Make sitemap lastmod and schema dateModified the same day

crawl-pdf-size.name: Linked PDF Size
crawl-pdf-size.description: Checks that linked PDF files are at most 10 MB
crawl-pdf-size.fix: Compress linked PDFs or split them so each file stays under 10 MB

schema-present.name: Structured Data Present
schema-present.description: Checks that JSON-LD or microdata structured data exists on the page
schema-present.fix: Add JSON-LD structured data for rich search results

schema-valid.name: Structured Data Valid JSON
schema-valid.description: Checks that all JSON-LD scripts contain valid, parseable JSON
schema-valid.fix: Fix JSON-LD syntax errors using Google Rich Results Test

schema-type.name: Structured Data Type Present
schema-type.description: Checks that JSON-LD structured data includes the required @type field
schema-type.fix: Use appropriate schema type (Article, Product, LocalBusiness, etc.)

schema-required-fields.name: Structured Data Required Fields
schema-required-fields.description: Checks that JSON-LD structured data includes required fields based on @type
schema-required-fields.fix: Add required schema fields for the chosen type

schema-article.name: Article Schema
schema-article.description: Validates Article, NewsArticle, BlogPosting, TechArticle, and ScholarlyArticle schemas for required and recommended fields
schema-article.fix: Add Article schema with headline, author (Person/Organization), datePublished, and image

schema-breadcrumb.name: Breadcrumb Schema
schema-breadcrumb.description: Validates BreadcrumbList schema presence on non-homepage pages and checks for proper itemListElement structure
schema-breadcrumb.fix: Add BreadcrumbList schema with itemListElement array for navigation hierarchy

schema-faq.name: FAQ Schema
schema-faq.description: Validates FAQPage schema for proper Question and Answer structure with required fields
schema-faq.fix: Add FAQPage schema with mainEntity array of Question items with acceptedAnswer

schema-local-business.name: LocalBusiness Schema
schema-local-business.description: Validates LocalBusiness, Restaurant, Store, and other local business schemas for required and recommended fields
schema-local-business.fix: Add LocalBusiness schema with name, address (PostalAddress), telephone, and geo coordinates

schema-organization.name: Organization Schema
schema-organization.description: Validates Organization schema for brand knowledge panel eligibility
schema-organization.fix: Add Organization schema with name, logo, url, and sameAs for social profiles

schema-product.name: Product Schema
schema-product.description: Validates Product schema for e-commerce rich results
schema-product.fix: Add Product schema with name, image, offers (price, priceCurrency, availability)

schema-review.name: Review Schema
schema-review.description: Validates Review and AggregateRating schema for star ratings
schema-review.fix: Add Review schema with itemReviewed, author, reviewRating; or AggregateRating with ratingValue, reviewCount

schema-video.name: Video Schema
schema-video.description: Validates VideoObject schema for video rich results
schema-video.fix: Add VideoObject schema with name, thumbnailUrl, uploadDate, and description

schema-website-search.name: WebSite Search Schema
schema-website-search.description: Checks for WebSite schema with sitelinks searchbox eligibility
schema-website-search.fix: Add WebSite schema with potentialAction SearchAction for sitelinks searchbox

schema-entity-id.name: Schema Entity @id
schema-entity-id.description: Checks that Organization, WebSite, Person, and Business entities have an absolute @id
schema-entity-id.fix: Give Organization, WebSite, and Person one absolute @id and reuse that URL on every page

schema-rating-scope.name: AggregateRating Scope
schema-rating-scope.description: Checks that AggregateRating is not on a legal or account URL and that ratingValue appears in visible text
schema-rating-scope.fix: Keep AggregateRating on the page it describes and show the same ratingValue in the visible text

schema-entity-conflict.name: Schema Entity Conflicts
schema-entity-conflict.description: Checks that one absolute @id is not declared with conflicting logos or phone numbers
schema-entity-conflict.fix: Give each absolute @id one logo and one telephone, and repeat those values on every page

schema-entity-dangling.name: Dangling Schema References
schema-entity-dangling.description: Checks that absolute publisher, author, and isPartOf @ids are declared somewhere in the crawl
schema-entity-dangling.fix: Declare every publisher, author, and isPartOf @id on at least one crawled page

schema-entity-type-drift.name: Schema Type Drift
schema-entity-type-drift.description: Checks that one absolute @id keeps the same @type across the crawl
schema-entity-type-drift.fix: Keep the same @type for an @id on every page that declares that identifier

schema-entity-split.name: Split Schema Identity
schema-entity-split.description: Checks that one organization or person name is not published under two absolute @ids
schema-entity-split.fix: Reuse one absolute @id for an organization or person name instead of minting a second one

a11y-aria-labels.name: ARIA Labels
a11y-aria-labels.description: Checks that interactive elements have accessible names
a11y-aria-labels.fix: Add aria-label or visible text to interactive elements for screen readers

a11y-color-contrast.name: Color Contrast
a11y-color-contrast.description: Checks for potential color contrast issues
a11y-color-contrast.fix: Ensure text has minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio against background

a11y-focus-visible.name: Focus Visible
a11y-focus-visible.fix: Keep visible focus indicators; use :focus-visible for keyboard users

a11y-form-labels.name: Form Labels
a11y-form-labels.description: Checks that form inputs have associated labels
a11y-form-labels.fix: Add <label for="id"> or aria-label to all form inputs

a11y-heading-order.name: Heading Order
a11y-heading-order.description: Checks that heading levels do not skip
a11y-heading-order.fix: Use proper heading hierarchy (H1→H2→H3); never skip levels

a11y-landmark-regions.name: Landmark Regions
a11y-landmark-regions.description: Checks for proper landmark regions (main, nav, header, footer)

a11y-link-text.name: Link Text
a11y-link-text.fix: Use descriptive link text instead of "click here" or "read more"

a11y-skip-link.name: Skip Link
a11y-skip-link.description: Checks for skip-to-content link for keyboard navigation
a11y-skip-link.fix: Add skip-to-content link at top of page for keyboard users

a11y-table-headers.name: Table Headers
a11y-table-headers.description: Checks that data tables have proper headers
a11y-table-headers.fix: Add <th scope="col/row"> to data table headers

a11y-touch-targets.name: Touch Targets
a11y-touch-targets.description: Checks for minimum touch target sizing hints
a11y-touch-targets.fix: Ensure interactive elements are at least 44x44 CSS pixels

a11y-video-captions.name: Video Captions
a11y-video-captions.description: Checks that videos have captions or transcripts
a11y-video-captions.fix: Add <track kind="captions"> or link to transcript for videos

a11y-zoom-disabled.name: Zoom Disabled
a11y-zoom-disabled.description: Checks if viewport meta tag disables user zoom
a11y-zoom-disabled.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale=1 from viewport

a11y-iframe-title.name: Frame Titles
a11y-iframe-title.description: Checks that <iframe> and <frame> elements have a title attribute
a11y-iframe-title.fix: Add a descriptive title attribute to every <iframe> and <frame>

a11y-object-alt.name: Object Alternative Text
a11y-object-alt.description: Checks that <object> elements provide a text alternative
a11y-object-alt.fix: Provide a text alternative for <object> elements via fallback content or aria-label

a11y-empty-heading.name: Headings Contain Content
a11y-empty-heading.description: Checks that no heading element is empty or inaccessible
a11y-empty-heading.fix: Remove empty headings or give them accessible text content

a11y-input-image-alt.name: Image Button Alt Text
a11y-input-image-alt.description: Checks that <input type="image"> elements have alt text
a11y-input-image-alt.fix: Add alt text to <input type="image"> describing the button action

a11y-main-landmark.name: Main Landmark
a11y-main-landmark.description: Checks that the page has exactly one <main> or role="main" landmark
a11y-main-landmark.fix: Add exactly one <main> landmark wrapping the primary page content

a11y-list-structure.name: List Structure
a11y-list-structure.description: Checks that lists contain only list items and that items sit inside a list
a11y-list-structure.fix: Put <li> items only inside <ul>/<ol>, and keep only <li> items inside lists

a11y-duplicate-id.name: Unique Element IDs
a11y-duplicate-id.description: Checks that no ID is used more than once, which breaks ARIA and label references
a11y-duplicate-id.fix: Make every id attribute unique; duplicate IDs break ARIA references and label associations

a11y-tabindex-positive.name: No Positive Tabindex
a11y-tabindex-positive.description: Checks that no element uses a tabindex greater than 0
a11y-tabindex-positive.fix: Use tabindex="0" or remove tabindex; positive values break the natural tab order

a11y-accesskey-unique.name: Unique Access Keys
a11y-accesskey-unique.description: Checks that no accesskey value is assigned to more than one element
a11y-accesskey-unique.fix: Assign each accesskey value to only one element; duplicate accesskeys are ambiguous

a11y-form-multiple-labels.name: Single Label Per Field
a11y-form-multiple-labels.description: Checks that no form control is targeted by more than one <label>
a11y-form-multiple-labels.fix: Associate each form control with a single label; remove duplicate labels

a11y-aria-valid.name: Valid ARIA Roles and Attributes
a11y-aria-valid.description: Checks that ARIA roles exist and aria-* attributes are spelled correctly
a11y-aria-valid.fix: Fix invalid ARIA roles and misspelled aria-* attributes; use valid ARIA names and values

a11y-aria-hidden-focusable.name: aria-hidden Not Over Focusable Content
a11y-aria-hidden-focusable.description: Checks that aria-hidden is not on the body or wrapping focusable elements
a11y-aria-hidden-focusable.fix: Remove aria-hidden from elements containing focusable content, or make that content unfocusable

a11y-svg-img-alt.name: SVG Image Alt Text
a11y-svg-img-alt.description: Checks that SVGs with an img role have an accessible name
a11y-svg-img-alt.fix: Add an accessible name (aria-label or <title>) to SVGs with role="img"

a11y-presentation-role-conflict.name: Presentation Role Conflicts
a11y-presentation-role-conflict.description: Checks that role="none"/"presentation" is not negated by ARIA or focusability
a11y-presentation-role-conflict.fix: Remove ARIA attributes and focusability from elements with role="presentation" or role="none"

a11y-valid-lang-element.name: Valid Element Language Tags
a11y-valid-lang-element.description: Checks that lang attributes on elements are well-formed BCP 47 tags
a11y-valid-lang-element.fix: Use well-formed BCP 47 language tags in lang attributes (e.g. "en", "en-GB")

a11y-redundant-alt.name: Non-Redundant Alt Text
a11y-redundant-alt.description: Checks that image alt text does not duplicate adjacent link or caption text
a11y-redundant-alt.fix: Remove alt text that duplicates adjacent link or caption text; use empty alt for decorative repeats

a11y-table-caption.name: Table Captions
a11y-table-caption.description: Checks that data tables use <caption> rather than a spanning cell
a11y-table-caption.fix: Add a <caption> element to data tables instead of a spanning header cell

a11y-identical-links-purpose.name: Identical Links Same Purpose
a11y-identical-links-purpose.description: Checks that links sharing the same text point to the same destination
a11y-identical-links-purpose.fix: Differentiate link text for links that share the same text but point to different destinations

a11y-label-name-mismatch.name: Accessible Name Matches Visible Label
a11y-label-name-mismatch.description: Checks that aria-label text contains the element visible text
a11y-label-name-mismatch.fix: Ensure the aria-label text contains the element visible label text

a11y-button-name.name: Button Accessible Name
a11y-button-name.description: Checks that buttons and role=button controls have an accessible name
a11y-button-name.fix: Give each button visible text, an aria-label, or an image alt

a11y-autocomplete.name: Autocomplete Tokens
a11y-autocomplete.description: Checks that email and tel inputs set the matching autocomplete token
a11y-autocomplete.fix: Set autocomplete="email" on email fields and autocomplete="tel" on telephone fields

a11y-xml-lang-mismatch.name: lang and xml:lang Mismatch
a11y-xml-lang-mismatch.description: Checks that lang and xml:lang on the html element name the same language
a11y-xml-lang-mismatch.fix: Set lang and xml:lang on the html element to the same language tag

a11y-aria-hidden-body.name: aria-hidden on Document
a11y-aria-hidden-body.description: Checks that html and body are not aria-hidden
a11y-aria-hidden-body.fix: Remove aria-hidden from the html and body elements

a11y-aria-required.name: Required ARIA Structure
a11y-aria-required.description: Checks that explicit ARIA widget roles have their required parent and child roles
a11y-aria-required.fix: Give tab, menuitem, option, and treeitem their required parent role, and give those parents a child

content-word-count.name: Word Count
content-word-count.description: Checks content length for thin content issues
content-word-count.fix: Expand thin content to at least 300 words for informational pages

content-reading-level.name: Reading Level
content-reading-level.description: Analyzes content readability using Flesch-Kincaid score
content-reading-level.fix: Simplify text for broader audience; aim for 8th grade reading level

content-keyword-stuffing.name: Keyword Stuffing
content-keyword-stuffing.description: Detects excessive keyword repetition in content
content-keyword-stuffing.fix: Write naturally; avoid repeating keywords excessively

content-article-links.name: Article Link Density
content-article-links.description: Checks that articles have appropriate internal and external links based on length
content-article-links.fix: Add relevant internal and external links within article content

content-broken-html.name: Broken HTML
content-broken-html.description: Checks for malformed HTML structure issues
content-broken-html.fix: Fix HTML validation errors using W3C validator

content-meta-in-body.name: Meta Tags in Body
content-meta-in-body.description: Detects meta tags incorrectly placed in document body
content-meta-in-body.fix: Move all <meta> tags from <body> to <head> section

content-mime-type.name: MIME Type Validation
content-mime-type.description: Validates Content-Type header for correct MIME type and charset
content-mime-type.fix: Ensure correct Content-Type header matches actual content

content-duplicate-description.name: Duplicate Description
content-duplicate-description.description: Checks for duplicate meta descriptions across the site
content-duplicate-description.fix: Use unique meta descriptions for each page

content-heading-hierarchy.name: Heading Hierarchy
content-heading-hierarchy.description: Checks that headings follow proper hierarchy (h1 before h2 before h3) with no skipped levels
content-heading-hierarchy.fix: Maintain proper heading order (H1 → H2 → H3, no skipping levels)

content-heading-length.name: Heading Content Length
content-heading-length.description: Checks that headings are between 10 and 70 characters
content-heading-length.fix: Keep headings concise (under 70 characters) and descriptive

content-heading-unique.name: Unique Heading Content
content-heading-unique.description: Checks that heading text is unique across the document
content-heading-unique.fix: Use unique headings that differ from page title and each other

content-text-html-ratio.name: Text to HTML Ratio
content-text-html-ratio.description: Checks the ratio of visible text content to total HTML size
content-text-html-ratio.fix: Increase text-to-HTML ratio; reduce unnecessary markup, inline styles, and scripts

content-title-same-as-h1.name: Title Same as H1
content-title-same-as-h1.description: Checks if the title tag and H1 heading are identical (should differ for keyword variety)
content-title-same-as-h1.fix: Differentiate title tag from H1; use the title for search display and H1 for on-page context

content-title-same-as-description.name: Title Same as Meta Description
content-title-same-as-description.description: Checks if the title tag and meta description contain identical text (they should differ)
content-title-same-as-description.fix: Write a distinct meta description that expands on the title and encourages clicks

content-title-pixel-width.name: Title Pixel Width
content-title-pixel-width.description: Estimates title tag pixel width to predict SERP truncation
content-title-pixel-width.fix: Keep title under ~580px pixel width to avoid truncation in Google search results

content-description-pixel-width.name: Description Pixel Width
content-description-pixel-width.description: Estimates meta description pixel width to predict SERP truncation
content-description-pixel-width.fix: Keep meta description under ~920px pixel width to avoid truncation in search results

content-duplicate-exact.name: Exact Duplicate Content
content-duplicate-exact.description: Detects exact duplicate content across crawled pages using content hashing
content-duplicate-exact.fix: Remove or consolidate pages with identical content; use canonical tags for intentional duplicates

content-duplicate-near.name: Near-Duplicate Content
content-duplicate-near.description: Detects near-duplicate content across crawled pages using trigram similarity
content-duplicate-near.fix: Differentiate pages with near-duplicate content; add unique value or consolidate with canonical tags

content-duplicate-h1.name: Duplicate H1 Across Pages
content-duplicate-h1.description: Detects pages whose h1 heading is the exact same text as another crawled page
content-duplicate-h1.fix: Give each page a unique H1 that reflects its specific topic

content-mojibake.name: Mojibake In Visible Text
content-mojibake.description: Checks visible text for UTF-8 bytes that were decoded as Latin-1 or Windows-1252
content-mojibake.fix: Re-save the page as UTF-8 and serve charset=utf-8 so curly quotes and accented letters are not shown corrupted

content-unrendered-markup.name: Unrendered Markup
content-unrendered-markup.description: Checks visible text for Markdown that was printed instead of rendered
content-unrendered-markup.fix: Render Markdown to HTML before publishing so visitors do not see literal **bold** or [label](url)

content-placeholder-text.name: Placeholder Text
content-placeholder-text.description: Checks visible text for unrendered template syntax and TODO or FIXME notes
content-placeholder-text.fix: Render templates before the page is served and remove TODO or FIXME notes from visible text

content-stale-copyright.name: Stale Copyright Year
content-stale-copyright.description: Checks the footer copyright year against the current year
content-stale-copyright.fix: Update the footer copyright year to the current year

content-date-agreement.name: Date Agreement
content-date-agreement.description: Checks that schema datePublished, visible time elements, and a year in the URL agree
content-date-agreement.fix: Make schema datePublished, the visible time element, and the year in the URL the same published year

content-hidden-text.name: Hidden Text
content-hidden-text.description: Checks for long text hidden with an inline style, excluding navigation, dialogs, and screen-reader text
content-hidden-text.fix: Remove long text hidden with an inline style; screen-reader text should use an sr-only class

content-thin-vs-site.name: Thin Versus Site Norm
content-thin-vs-site.description: Checks that a page is not far shorter than the median page of the same kind
content-thin-vs-site.fix: Bring this page toward the word count of the other pages of the same kind

content-title-pattern.name: Title Template
content-title-pattern.description: Checks that the page title follows the suffix most of the site uses
content-title-pattern.fix: Use the same title suffix the rest of the site uses, including the separator

social-og-title.name: Open Graph Title
social-og-title.description: Checks that a <meta property="og:title"> tag exists in the document
social-og-title.fix: Add <meta property="og:title" content="..."> for social sharing

social-og-description.name: Open Graph Description
social-og-description.description: Checks that a <meta property="og:description"> tag exists in the document
social-og-description.fix: Add <meta property="og:description" content="..."> for social sharing

social-og-image.name: Open Graph Image
social-og-image.description: Checks that a <meta property="og:image"> tag exists with a valid URL

social-og-image-size.name: Open Graph Image Size
social-og-image-size.description: Checks that og:image has recommended dimensions (1200x630) via og:image:width and og:image:height meta tags
social-og-image-size.fix: Add og:image:width (1200) and og:image:height (630) meta tags for optimal display

social-twitter-card.name: Twitter Card
social-twitter-card.description: Checks that a <meta name="twitter:card"> tag exists with a valid card type

social-og-url.name: Open Graph URL
social-og-url.description: Checks that a <meta property="og:url"> tag exists with a valid URL
social-og-url.fix: Add <meta property="og:url" content="..."> matching canonical URL

social-og-url-canonical.name: Open Graph URL Matches Canonical
social-og-url-canonical.description: Checks that og:url matches the canonical URL for consistent SEO signals
social-og-url-canonical.fix: Ensure og:url matches canonical URL exactly for consistent SEO signals

social-share-buttons.name: Social Share Buttons
social-share-buttons.description: Checks for social sharing buttons on content pages to encourage social engagement
social-share-buttons.fix: Add social share buttons for Facebook, Twitter/X, and LinkedIn

social-profiles.name: Social Profile Links
social-profiles.description: Checks for links to social media profiles in header, footer, or structured data
social-profiles.fix: Add social profile links in header/footer; include sameAs in Organization schema

eeat-about-page.name: About Page
eeat-about-page.description: Checks for an about/company page with content
eeat-about-page.fix: Add an "About" or "About Us" page explaining who you are and your expertise

eeat-affiliate-disclosure.name: Affiliate Disclosure
eeat-affiliate-disclosure.description: Checks for affiliate and sponsored content disclosures
eeat-affiliate-disclosure.fix: Add FTC-compliant disclosure near affiliate content and links

eeat-author-byline.name: Author Bylines
eeat-author-byline.description: Checks for visible author names on content pages
eeat-author-byline.fix: Add author attribution with name, bio, and link to author page

eeat-author-expertise.name: Author Expertise
eeat-author-expertise.description: Checks for author credentials and expertise indicators
eeat-author-expertise.fix: Add author credentials, professional social links, and relevant experience

eeat-citations.name: Citations
eeat-citations.description: Checks for citations to authoritative external sources
eeat-citations.fix: Link to authoritative sources (.gov, .edu, research papers) to support claims

eeat-contact-page.name: Contact Page
eeat-contact-page.description: Checks for contact page with multiple contact methods
eeat-contact-page.fix: Add contact page with email, phone, form, and/or physical address

eeat-content-dates.name: Content Dates
eeat-content-dates.description: Checks for published and modified dates on content
eeat-content-dates.fix: Add datePublished and dateModified to Article schema or use <time> elements

eeat-disclaimers.name: Disclaimers
eeat-disclaimers.description: Checks for appropriate disclaimers on sensitive content
eeat-disclaimers.fix: Add appropriate disclaimers for medical, financial, or legal content (YMYL)

eeat-editorial-policy.name: Editorial Policy
eeat-editorial-policy.description: Checks for editorial and content policy pages
eeat-editorial-policy.fix: Add editorial policy page documenting content standards and review process

eeat-physical-address.name: Physical Address
eeat-physical-address.description: Checks for visible physical address information
eeat-physical-address.fix: Add business address using Schema.org PostalAddress for local trust signals

eeat-privacy-policy.name: Privacy Policy
eeat-privacy-policy.description: Checks for privacy policy page linked from footer
eeat-privacy-policy.fix: Add privacy policy link in footer of every page; document data collection practices

eeat-terms-of-service.name: Terms of Service
eeat-terms-of-service.description: Checks for terms of service page
eeat-terms-of-service.fix: Add ToS link in footer (especially for e-commerce, SaaS, and UGC platforms)

eeat-trust-signals.name: Trust Signals
eeat-trust-signals.description: Checks for trust badges, certifications, and social proof
eeat-trust-signals.fix: Add customer reviews, certifications, security badges, or media mentions

eeat-ymyl-detection.name: YMYL Detection
eeat-ymyl-detection.description: Detects Your Money Your Life (YMYL) content
eeat-ymyl-detection.fix: Strengthen E-E-A-T signals on YMYL pages (health, finance, legal) with expert authors and citations

eeat-geo-meta.name: Geo Meta Tags
eeat-geo-meta.description: Checks that a page with local-business schema also sets a geo meta tag
eeat-geo-meta.fix: Add geo.region, geo.placename, or geo.position on pages that publish local-business schema

eeat-nap-consistency.name: NAP Consistency
eeat-nap-consistency.description: Checks that one organization name keeps a single phone number and address across the crawl
eeat-nap-consistency.fix: Publish one phone number and one postal address for each organization name

url-slug-keywords.name: Slug Keywords
url-slug-keywords.description: Checks if URL slug contains relevant keywords rather than generic identifiers
url-slug-keywords.fix: Use descriptive keywords in URL slugs (e.g., /blue-running-shoes instead of /product-12345)

url-stop-words.name: URL Stop Words
url-stop-words.description: Flags common stop words (a, an, the, of, etc.) in URL slugs that add length without SEO value
url-stop-words.fix: Remove stop words (a, the, of) from URLs; prefer /best-running-shoes over /the-best-running-shoes-for-you

url-uppercase.name: Uppercase Letters in URL
url-uppercase.description: Checks if URL path contains uppercase letters which can cause duplicate content issues
url-uppercase.fix: Convert uppercase characters in URLs to lowercase; set up 301 redirects from uppercase versions

url-underscores.name: Underscores in URL
url-underscores.description: Checks if URL path uses underscores instead of hyphens; Google recommends hyphens as word separators
url-underscores.fix: Replace underscores with hyphens in URLs; search engines treat hyphens as word separators

url-double-slash.name: Double Slashes in URL Path
url-double-slash.description: Checks for double slashes in the URL path which indicate malformed URLs
url-double-slash.fix: Remove double slashes from URL paths; configure server to normalize or redirect

url-spaces.name: Spaces in URL
url-spaces.description: Checks for encoded spaces (%20) or literal spaces in the URL
url-spaces.fix: Remove spaces from URLs (encoded as %20 or +); use hyphens instead

url-non-ascii.name: Non-ASCII Characters in URL
url-non-ascii.description: Checks for non-ASCII characters in the URL path that may cause encoding issues
url-non-ascii.fix: Replace non-ASCII characters in URLs with ASCII equivalents or transliterate

url-length.name: URL Length
url-length.description: Checks if the full URL length is within recommended limits for SEO
url-length.fix: Keep URLs under 2048 characters; shorter URLs (under 75 chars) are easier to share and remember

url-repetitive-path.name: Repetitive Path Segments
url-repetitive-path.description: Checks for consecutive duplicate segments in the URL path (e.g., /blog/blog/)
url-repetitive-path.fix: Remove repetitive path segments (e.g., /blog/blog/post); simplify URL structure

url-parameters.name: Excessive URL Parameters
url-parameters.description: Checks for excessive query parameters that can fragment crawl budget and dilute page authority
url-parameters.fix: Minimize URL parameters; use clean URL paths instead of query strings for important pages

url-session-ids.name: Session IDs in URL
url-session-ids.description: Checks for session identifiers in the URL that cause duplicate content and security issues
url-session-ids.fix: Remove session IDs from URLs; use cookies instead to prevent duplicate content issues

url-tracking-params.name: Tracking Parameters in URL
url-tracking-params.description: Checks for common tracking parameters (UTM, gclid, fbclid, etc.) that create duplicate URL variations
url-tracking-params.fix: Strip tracking parameters (utm_*, gclid, fbclid) from canonical URLs; use canonical tags or parameter handling in GSC

url-internal-search.name: Internal Search URL
url-internal-search.description: Checks if the URL appears to be an internal search results page that should be noindexed
url-internal-search.fix: Block internal search result pages from indexing with noindex or robots.txt; they create thin content

url-http-https-duplicate.name: HTTP/HTTPS Canonical Mismatch
url-http-https-duplicate.description: Checks if the canonical URL uses a different protocol (HTTP vs HTTPS) than the page URL
url-http-https-duplicate.fix: Redirect HTTP version to HTTPS and set canonical to HTTPS to prevent duplicate content

mobile-font-size.name: Mobile Font Size
mobile-font-size.description: Checks for readable font sizes on mobile devices
mobile-font-size.fix: Use minimum 16px for body text, 12px absolute minimum; prefer relative units (rem, em)

mobile-horizontal-scroll.name: Horizontal Scroll
mobile-horizontal-scroll.description: Checks for elements that may cause horizontal scrolling on mobile
mobile-horizontal-scroll.fix: Use max-width: 100% on images, overflow-x: auto on tables, responsive iframes

mobile-interstitials.name: Intrusive Interstitials
mobile-interstitials.description: Detects potentially intrusive mobile popups and overlays
mobile-interstitials.fix: Remove popups that cover main content on mobile; use compact banners instead of full-screen overlays

mobile-viewport-width.name: Viewport Fixed Width
mobile-viewport-width.description: Checks if viewport meta tag sets a fixed width instead of device-width
mobile-viewport-width.fix: Remove fixed width values from viewport meta tag; use width=device-width for responsive design

mobile-multiple-viewports.name: Multiple Viewport Tags
mobile-multiple-viewports.description: Checks for multiple viewport meta tags which can cause confusion
mobile-multiple-viewports.fix: Remove duplicate viewport meta tags; keep only one with width=device-width, initial-scale=1

mobile-image-maps.name: Image Maps
mobile-image-maps.description: Checks for <map>/<area> image maps, which are not mobile-friendly
mobile-image-maps.fix: Replace image maps with SVG links or positioned anchors over a fluid image

mobile-viewport-content.name: Viewport Meta Content
mobile-viewport-content.description: Checks the viewport meta tag for width, initial-scale, and minimum-scale directives

mobile-parity-content.name: Mobile Content Parity
mobile-parity-content.description: Checks that the mobile render contains as much body content as desktop
mobile-parity-content.fix: Serve the same main content on mobile as desktop; mobile-first indexing uses the mobile version

mobile-parity-title.name: Mobile Title & Description Parity
mobile-parity-title.description: Checks that the title and meta description match between mobile and desktop
mobile-parity-title.fix: Serve the same title and meta description on mobile and desktop

mobile-parity-canonical.name: Mobile Canonical Parity
mobile-parity-canonical.description: Checks that the canonical URL matches between mobile and desktop
mobile-parity-canonical.fix: Serve the same canonical URL on mobile and desktop

mobile-parity-structured-data.name: Mobile Structured Data Parity
mobile-parity-structured-data.description: Checks that JSON-LD structured data is present on mobile as well as desktop
mobile-parity-structured-data.fix: Include the same JSON-LD structured data on mobile as on desktop

mobile-parity-links.name: Mobile Internal Link Parity
mobile-parity-links.description: Checks that mobile exposes a comparable number of internal links to desktop
mobile-parity-links.fix: Expose the same internal links on mobile as desktop; hidden mobile links are lost to mobile-first indexing

i18n-lang-attribute.name: Lang Attribute
i18n-lang-attribute.description: Checks that the <html> element has a valid lang attribute
i18n-lang-attribute.fix: Add lang attribute to <html> tag: <html lang="en">

i18n-hreflang.name: Hreflang Tags
i18n-hreflang.description: Checks for hreflang link elements for international targeting
i18n-hreflang.fix: Add <link rel="alternate" hreflang="xx"> for each language version with self-reference

i18n-hreflang-return-links.name: Hreflang Return Links
i18n-hreflang-return-links.description: Checks if hreflang annotations include self-referencing link for the current page
i18n-hreflang-return-links.fix: Add reciprocal hreflang links; page A linking to page B must have page B linking back to page A

i18n-hreflang-to-noindex.name: Hreflang to Noindex Conflict
i18n-hreflang-to-noindex.description: Checks if page has both hreflang annotations and noindex directive
i18n-hreflang-to-noindex.fix: Remove noindex from hreflang target pages or remove them from hreflang annotations

i18n-hreflang-to-non-canonical.name: Hreflang to Non-Canonical URL
i18n-hreflang-to-non-canonical.description: Checks if hreflang annotations point to non-canonical URLs
i18n-hreflang-to-non-canonical.fix: Point hreflang annotations to canonical URLs only; avoid linking to non-canonical versions

i18n-hreflang-to-broken.name: Hreflang to Broken URLs
i18n-hreflang-to-broken.description: Checks hreflang URLs for malformed or obviously broken URLs
i18n-hreflang-to-broken.fix: Fix broken hreflang target URLs (4xx/5xx); ensure all hreflang targets are accessible

i18n-hreflang-to-redirect.name: Hreflang to Redirect
i18n-hreflang-to-redirect.description: Checks if hreflang URLs may trigger redirects (HTTP on HTTPS site)
i18n-hreflang-to-redirect.fix: Update hreflang annotations to point to final URLs, not redirecting URLs

i18n-hreflang-conflicting.name: Conflicting Hreflang Annotations
i18n-hreflang-conflicting.description: Checks for hreflang conflicts: one language code pointing to multiple URLs, one URL targeted by multiple codes, or multiple self-referencing codes
i18n-hreflang-conflicting.fix: Resolve conflicting hreflang annotations where multiple pages target the same language-region

i18n-hreflang-relative-url.name: Hreflang Relative URLs
i18n-hreflang-relative-url.description: Checks that hreflang annotations use absolute URLs, not relative ones
i18n-hreflang-relative-url.fix: Use absolute URLs in hreflang annotations; relative URLs are not valid

i18n-hreflang-x-default.name: Hreflang Annotation Also X-Default
i18n-hreflang-x-default.description: Reports when an hreflang language annotation targets the same URL as x-default
i18n-hreflang-x-default.fix: Confirm the overlap is intentional; x-default is a fallback, not a language claim

i18n-hreflang-lang-mismatch.name: Hreflang Lang Mismatch
i18n-hreflang-lang-mismatch.description: Checks if page lang attribute matches hreflang self-reference language code
i18n-hreflang-lang-mismatch.fix: Ensure the hreflang language code matches the actual content language of the target page

i18n-hreflang-multiple-methods.name: Hreflang Multiple Methods
i18n-hreflang-multiple-methods.description: Checks if hreflang is specified via both HTML link tags and HTTP headers
i18n-hreflang-multiple-methods.fix: Use a single hreflang implementation method (HTML tags, HTTP headers, or sitemap); avoid mixing methods

i18n-hreflang-incoming-invalid.name: Invalid Incoming Hreflang Annotations
i18n-hreflang-incoming-invalid.description: Checks that hreflang annotations from other crawled pages targeting this URL use valid language/region codes
i18n-hreflang-incoming-invalid.fix: Fix source pages to use valid hreflang codes (ISO 639-1 language, optional ISO 3166-1 region, e.g. "en-GB")

legal-cookie-consent.name: Cookie Consent
legal-cookie-consent.description: Checks for cookie consent mechanism presence
legal-cookie-consent.fix: Add a cookie consent banner using CookieYes, OneTrust, or Cookiebot; allow users to accept/reject non-essential cookies

js-rendered-title.name: Rendered Title Present
js-rendered-title.description: Checks that a <title> tag exists in the rendered DOM after JavaScript execution
js-rendered-title.fix: Ensure the page title is present in raw HTML, not only injected by JavaScript

js-rendered-description.name: Rendered Meta Description Present
js-rendered-description.description: Checks that a meta description exists in the rendered DOM after JavaScript execution
js-rendered-description.fix: Include meta description in server-rendered HTML; don't rely solely on JavaScript to inject it

js-rendered-h1.name: Rendered H1 Present
js-rendered-h1.description: Checks that an H1 heading exists in the rendered DOM after JavaScript execution
js-rendered-h1.fix: Include H1 heading in server-rendered HTML for faster indexing; don't rely solely on client-side rendering

js-rendered-canonical.name: Rendered Canonical Present
js-rendered-canonical.description: Checks that a canonical link tag exists in the rendered DOM after JavaScript execution
js-rendered-canonical.fix: Include canonical tag in server-rendered HTML; JavaScript-injected canonicals may be missed by crawlers

js-canonical-mismatch.name: Canonical Mismatch (Raw vs Rendered)
js-canonical-mismatch.description: Checks if the canonical URL differs between raw HTML and rendered DOM
js-canonical-mismatch.fix: Fix canonical URL mismatch between raw HTML and rendered DOM; ensure they agree on the preferred URL

js-noindex-mismatch.name: Noindex/Nofollow Mismatch (Raw vs Rendered)
js-noindex-mismatch.description: Checks if the noindex or nofollow directives change between raw HTML and rendered DOM
js-noindex-mismatch.fix: Fix noindex mismatch between raw and rendered HTML; JavaScript should not add or remove noindex directives

js-title-modified.name: Title Modified by JavaScript
js-title-modified.description: Checks if the page title is modified by JavaScript execution
js-title-modified.fix: Avoid JavaScript that modifies the title tag after page load; search engines may use the original title

js-description-modified.name: Meta Description Modified by JavaScript
js-description-modified.description: Checks if the meta description is modified by JavaScript execution
js-description-modified.fix: Avoid JavaScript that modifies meta description after page load; include final description in server HTML

js-h1-modified.name: H1 Modified by JavaScript
js-h1-modified.description: Checks if the H1 heading is modified by JavaScript execution
js-h1-modified.fix: Avoid JavaScript that modifies H1 after page load; include final H1 in server-rendered HTML

js-rendered-content.name: Rendered Content Dependency
js-rendered-content.description: Checks if significant content is only present after JavaScript rendering
js-rendered-content.fix: Ensure main content is in server-rendered HTML; JavaScript-only content may not be indexed reliably

js-rendered-links.name: Rendered Links Dependency
js-rendered-links.description: Checks if important links are only present after JavaScript rendering
js-rendered-links.fix: Include navigation links in server-rendered HTML; JavaScript-only links may not be discovered by crawlers

js-blocked-resources.name: Blocked JavaScript Resources
js-blocked-resources.description: Checks if JavaScript resources may be blocked by robots.txt
js-blocked-resources.fix: Unblock JavaScript and CSS files in robots.txt so search engines can render your pages correctly

js-ssr-check.name: Server-Side Rendering Check
js-ssr-check.description: Checks if the page uses SSR or relies on client-side rendering only
js-ssr-check.fix: Implement server-side rendering (SSR) or static generation for important content pages

js-console-errors.name: JavaScript Console Errors
js-console-errors.description: Reports uncaught JavaScript exceptions and console errors captured while rendering the page
js-console-errors.fix: Fix uncaught JavaScript errors; a halted script never writes the content or tags it was responsible for

js-failed-requests.name: Failed Resource Requests
js-failed-requests.description: Reports scripts, stylesheets and other subresources that failed to load while rendering
js-failed-requests.fix: Fix failing script and stylesheet requests; resources that never load cannot render their content

js-document-write.name: No document.write()
js-document-write.description: Checks that inline scripts do not use document.write()
js-document-write.fix: Replace document.write() with DOM manipulation methods; it blocks the HTML parser and harms rendering

redirect-meta-refresh.name: No Meta Refresh Redirect
redirect-meta-refresh.description: Checks for meta refresh redirects that should use server-side 301 redirects
redirect-meta-refresh.fix: Replace <meta http-equiv="refresh"> redirects with server-side 301 redirects

redirect-javascript.name: No JavaScript Redirects
redirect-javascript.description: Checks for JavaScript-based redirects that search engines may not follow
redirect-javascript.fix: Replace JavaScript redirects (window.location) with server-side 301 redirects for crawlability

redirect-http-refresh.name: No HTTP Refresh Header
redirect-http-refresh.description: Checks for the non-standard Refresh HTTP header that should use 301/302 status codes
redirect-http-refresh.fix: Replace HTTP Refresh headers with proper 301/302 redirect status codes

redirect-loop.name: No Redirect Loops
redirect-loop.description: Checks that the redirect chain does not contain loops
redirect-loop.fix: Fix redirect loop by ensuring the redirect chain terminates at a final, non-redirecting URL

redirect-type.name: Redirect Type
redirect-type.description: Checks that redirects use permanent (301/308) status codes for SEO
redirect-type.fix: Use 301 (permanent) for moved pages and 302 (temporary) only for truly temporary redirects

redirect-broken.name: No Broken Redirects
redirect-broken.description: Checks that redirect chains resolve to a valid (200) page
redirect-broken.fix: Fix broken redirects that lead to 4xx/5xx errors; update to valid destination URLs

redirect-resource.name: No HTTP Resource Redirects
redirect-resource.description: Checks that HTTPS pages do not reference HTTP resources that cause redirect chains
redirect-resource.fix: Fix redirecting resources (CSS, JS, images); serve them directly without redirects for better performance

redirect-case-normalization.name: URL Case Normalization
redirect-case-normalization.description: Checks that URLs are properly normalized by case to avoid duplicate content
redirect-case-normalization.fix: Ensure URLs are case-normalized; redirect mixed-case URLs to lowercase canonical versions

redirect-resource-broken.name: No Broken Resource Redirects
redirect-resource-broken.description: Checks that redirected page resources do not resolve to a 4xx or 5xx status
redirect-resource-broken.fix: Update resource URLs to point directly at a working destination instead of a broken redirect

redirect-resource-loop.name: No Resource Redirect Loops
redirect-resource-loop.description: Checks that page resources are not caught in redirect loops
redirect-resource-loop.fix: Fix the resource redirect target so the chain resolves to a final resource instead of looping

redirect-resource-chain.name: No Resource Redirect Chains
redirect-resource-chain.description: Checks that page resources do not resolve through multi-hop redirect chains
redirect-resource-chain.fix: Update resource URLs to point directly at the final destination, skipping redirect hops

htmlval-missing-doctype.name: DOCTYPE Declaration
htmlval-missing-doctype.description: Checks that the HTML document starts with a <!DOCTYPE> declaration
htmlval-missing-doctype.fix: Add <!DOCTYPE html> as the first line of HTML documents for standards mode rendering

htmlval-missing-charset.name: Charset Declaration
htmlval-missing-charset.description: Checks for a <meta charset> or Content-Type meta tag in the document head
htmlval-missing-charset.fix: Add <meta charset="utf-8"> as the first element in <head> for proper character encoding

htmlval-invalid-head.name: Valid Head Elements
htmlval-invalid-head.description: Checks that <head> contains only valid metadata elements
htmlval-invalid-head.fix: Move non-metadata elements out of <head>; only meta, link, title, style, script, and base belong there

htmlval-noscript-in-head.name: Noscript in Head
htmlval-noscript-in-head.description: Checks that <noscript> inside <head> contains only permitted elements (link, style, meta)
htmlval-noscript-in-head.fix: Move <noscript> content from <head> to <body>; <noscript> in <head> can cause parsing issues

htmlval-multiple-heads.name: Single Head Element
htmlval-multiple-heads.description: Checks that the document contains only one <head> element
htmlval-multiple-heads.fix: Remove duplicate <head> elements; HTML documents must have exactly one <head>

htmlval-size-limit.name: HTML Document Size
htmlval-size-limit.description: Checks that the HTML document size is within reasonable limits
htmlval-size-limit.fix: Reduce HTML document size below 5MB; large HTML slows parsing and may not be fully indexed

htmlval-lorem-ipsum.name: No Placeholder Text
htmlval-lorem-ipsum.description: Checks for lorem ipsum and other placeholder text in the page content
htmlval-lorem-ipsum.fix: Replace placeholder "Lorem ipsum" text with actual content before publishing

htmlval-multiple-titles.name: Single Title Element
htmlval-multiple-titles.description: Checks that the document contains at most one <title> element
htmlval-multiple-titles.fix: Remove duplicate <title> tags; HTML documents must have exactly one <title> in <head>

htmlval-multiple-descriptions.name: Single Meta Description
htmlval-multiple-descriptions.description: Checks that the document contains at most one <meta name="description"> element
htmlval-multiple-descriptions.fix: Remove duplicate meta description tags; use only one <meta name="description"> per page

htmlval-title-outside-head.name: Title Element Inside Head
htmlval-title-outside-head.description: Checks that no <title> element appears outside of <head>
htmlval-title-outside-head.fix: Move the <title> element into the <head>; titles outside <head> may be ignored by search engines

htmlval-base-url.name: Valid Base URL
htmlval-base-url.description: Checks that the document has at most one <base> element with a valid href
htmlval-base-url.fix: Use at most one <base> element with a valid, non-empty href; relative links resolve against it

geo-semantic-html.name: Semantic HTML Structure
geo-semantic-html.description: Checks if the page uses semantic HTML5 elements that help AI systems understand content structure
geo-semantic-html.fix: Use semantic HTML elements (<article>, <section>, <nav>, <aside>) instead of generic <div> tags

geo-content-structure.name: Content Structure for AI
geo-content-structure.description: Checks if the page has clear content structure for AI extraction (main area, heading hierarchy, paragraphs, structured data)
geo-content-structure.fix: Structure content with clear headings, lists, and paragraphs for AI comprehension and featured snippets

geo-ai-bot-access.name: AI Bot Access
geo-ai-bot-access.description: Checks whether robots.txt blocks AI answer engines (OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended). Training-only crawlers such as GPTBot are reported but not penalised.
geo-ai-bot-access.fix: Allow AI crawlers (GPTBot, Claude, Perplexity) in robots.txt for AI search visibility

geo-llms-txt.name: llms.txt Reference
geo-llms-txt.description: Checks if the page references an llms.txt file for AI discoverability (emerging standard)
geo-llms-txt.fix: Add /llms.txt file to provide AI-friendly site information and content guidance

geo-schema-drift.name: Schema Content Drift
geo-schema-drift.description: Compares JSON-LD structured data against visible page content for consistency
geo-schema-drift.fix: Ensure JSON-LD structured data accurately reflects visible page content; fix mismatches between schema and text

geo-content-signals.name: Content-Signal Policy
geo-content-signals.description: Checks robots.txt Content-Signal syntax and contradictions with training-crawler blocks
geo-content-signals.fix: Fix Content-Signal syntax and set ai-train=no when robots.txt disallows training crawlers

geo-noai-signals.name: AI Opt-Out Directives
geo-noai-signals.description: Reports noai and noimageai in robots meta tags and the X-Robots-Tag header
geo-noai-signals.fix: noai and noimageai are reported only; remove them if you want AI answers to quote this page

geo-agents-md.name: AGENTS.md
geo-agents-md.description: Checks that the origin publishes an AGENTS.md file rather than an HTML fallback
geo-agents-md.fix: Publish /AGENTS.md as text or Markdown, not as the site HTML fallback

geo-well-known.name: Well-Known Agent Manifest
geo-well-known.description: Checks for an MCP or agent-card manifest under .well-known
geo-well-known.fix: Publish /.well-known/mcp.json or /.well-known/agent-card.json for agents that should call this site

geo-rsl-license.name: Robots License Target
geo-rsl-license.description: Checks that a robots.txt License URL resolves to a license document
geo-rsl-license.fix: Point the robots.txt License directive at a document that returns 200 and describes the license

geo-markdown-response.name: Markdown Response
geo-markdown-response.description: Checks that the origin can serve a Markdown representation of its root
geo-markdown-response.fix: Serve Markdown for / via Accept: text/markdown, or publish /index.md

geo-markdown-page.name: Markdown For This URL
geo-markdown-page.description: Checks that a non-root URL has a Markdown representation
geo-markdown-page.fix: Serve Markdown for this URL via Accept: text/markdown, or publish the same path with a .md suffix

geo-pay-per-crawl.name: Pay-Per-Crawl Response
geo-pay-per-crawl.description: Checks that an HTTP 402 response includes payment terms
geo-pay-per-crawl.fix: Add a Pay or Crawler-Price header, or a payment link, when the response is HTTP 402
